phase_map.name: Output Contract Hardening
phase_map.note: Shared JSON extraction, repair/diagnostics, truncation; later Package-B regression fixes included.

phase_map.name: Provider normalization and P2.5 judge parser
phase_map.note: Legacy adapters remain research APIs; supported v1 audit uses dedicated gated live adapter or recording provider.

phase_map.name: Case library, taxonomy, case intake
phase_map.note: Include retired/quarantined cases and curator history, not just active synthetic cases; provisional expansion remains separate.

phase_map.name: Library run harness, stability and gold corrections
phase_map.note: Historical 22 ignored library-run folders contain 88 manifest/results/summary files; retain approved snapshots under historical evidence, never execute live commands from old docs.

phase_map.name: Diagnostics, proxy IAA, curation, holdout governance and bounded replication
phase_map.note: Four-rater model revalidation is proxy IAA, not human IAA. Sealed HLD mapping/gold/evaluator packet remains excluded. Plan-only condition experiment remains not executed. Later H1/S1 raw records and consumed authorizations are historical data, not executable permission.

phase_map.name: Confidence validity, calibration, report prototype, paired prompt-only pilot
phase_map.note: Four existing anonymized external 27-record envelopes are required for result regeneration. Synthetic fixture generators already tracked. This historical package-level comparison does not satisfy final v1 efficacy gate.

phase_map.name: Robustness experiment and deterministic artifact-release gates
phase_map.note: 420+420 historical raw records and model-specific BLOCK findings preserved. Curator dossier outcome comes from latest integrated closeout; earlier readiness audit still awaiting decision is historical. ASA local verifier input is ignored and rights-sensitive, not needed for tracked suite.

phase_map.name: Proposition ledger, semantic/evidence typing, transformations and host judgment
phase_map.note: 18 frozen acceptance cases are in test_phase8_acceptance.py. Current assessment AA-P8/1.3, host AA-P8-HOST/1.1, raw ledger AA-P8/1.0. Exact quotation alone does not prove semantic inference.

phase_map.name: Disagreement review, durable histories, bounded variants and human decisions
phase_map.note: Current AA-P9/1.3; preserve earlier PARTIAL history and fixed blocker regression. Unresolved state means automatic processing ended, not a staffed human review queue.

phase_map.name: Canonical audit CLI, immutable bundles, render QA, live ledger and offline replay
phase_map.note: Internal technical v1.0.0 implemented; final code not newly live validated. Only audit validate/run/inspect/review/release is supported. R1 scientific efficacy gate remains unfulfilled; canonical PDF unsupported.
